title: Attribute access followed by domain content service
purpose: Increase semantic diversity by combining an attribute/read-style request with a domain-management confirmed service, giving the corpus two different confirmed service tags and parser branches in one sequence without relying on cosmetic framing changes.
expected_behavior: The target should parse two valid confirmed requests in sequence, first entering variable-access-attribute handling and then entering the StoreDomainContent confirmed-service path.
constraints_preserved: For MMS over RFC1006, prefer a TPKT header beginning with version 0x03.
Keep the TPKT total-length field consistent with the complete message.
Diversify association, discovery, read, write and reporting paths.
Use documented confirmed service tag values [6] and [35] to maximize parser entry-point diversity.
issue_safety_notes: The sequence stays within compact, valid confirmed-service wrappers and does not attempt malformed sizes, negative-length analogues, or exact reproduction of any issue payload. The pair is intended for safe branch coverage only.
